title: Every agent starts with the harness's default tools
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0068 no longer matches the current design.
decision: Every agent starts with the harness's default tools, with no isolation, no withheld verbs and no limit on whom it dispatches; anything is narrowed only once a role is observed doing harm with it (0142).
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
